'''Lonka''' was a member of an unidentified purple-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species who served as a bodyguard to [[Cabrool Nuum]], leader of the [[House of Nuum]]. He guarded [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] while he was kept in the House of Nuum's dungeon.
